changed: The program matrix now grows its rows and column headers with your system text size, and you can press and hold a clipped dance title or move name to read it in full. The hide-column button now sits above the move name instead of over it, so column headers are taller.

On phones and tablets, dropdowns and the small buttons in the figure parameter editors, the figure-of-your-own and compound-figure editors, and tappable tag chips in the Collection list are now full-size touch targets.
After Move up or Move down in the difficulty levels, custom-field choices and matrix columns lists, a screen reader announces the item's new position.

Spacing, corner radii and font weights across the app now come from shared values. A few paddings moved by up to 4 px to the nearest step (Programs rows, and Collection rows on desktop, are 4 px taller; on phones and tablets Collection rows are taller still, because the row and its tag chips are now full-size touch targets), and the few bits of text that asked for a semi-bold weight the body font does not include now ask for the bold weight it was drawn with.
